Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

beatpool (development version)

  • Raydonal Ospina is now the sole author and copyright holder; Abel Borges is acknowledged in the README.

  • The package now reproduces every table, figure and number of the accompanying article: the scripts in system.file("article", package = "beatpool") download the data and run the analysis (see the vignette “Reproducing the article”).

  • New download_physionet() downloads a PhysioNet database, and read_database() reads every record of a WFDB database into beat matrices with the settings of the article.

  • New attention over transmitted moments. attention_weights() and pool_attention() score each transmitted moment against a query moment of the beats to be compressed and pool the moments with softmax weights; equal weights are the limit of infinite temperature. Options: symmetric projection and cosine scores, sparsemax weights, a sink key holding the mean moment, a subtracted mean moment (differential attention), interpolation with the query moment, several heads and sparse weights.

  • New select_attention() and select_tau(): settings chosen by leave-one-out over the transmitted moments, optionally with queries of the size that a new record will have.

  • New refine_moments(): self-attention among records with a symmetric, doubly stochastic matrix found by Sinkhorn iterations; it leaves the mean moment unchanged.

  • New stream_attention(): one basis per block of beats, with the moment of the earlier beats as query.

beatpool 0.2.0

  • New energy_moment() and pool_energy(): moments of beats normalised by their energy, optimal for the mean per-beat relative error.
  • New pool_shared() and select_shared(): several shared bases fitted from the moments already transmitted by the records.

beatpool 0.1.0

  • First version: moment pooling, direction pooling, hierarchical pooling, residual imputation, metrics, simulation and a WFDB reader in R.
